In 1993, Ryu and Ken are pulled back into the arena: Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warriors tournament.
Russia, 2022. Gleb, a prosperous businessman, sees his troubles grow until they turn violent.
In the Beauce region, 11-year-old Christophe must wear a corset. He grows up, discovers music and meets Clara.

articles.titre: Arlo: the camera pays the rent, the subscription makes the profit
articles.chapo: In Q2 2026, 59.7% of this camera maker's revenue came from subscriptions.
paragraphes: Arlo sells connected security cameras, but most of its revenue is no longer hardware. In its August 6, 2026 release (quarter ended June 28), the company reports $155.9 million in revenue: $93.0 million from subscriptions and services and $62.9 million from products.
The key is margin: 81.1% gross margin (GAAP) on subscriptions, against 48.2% overall. The company has 6.3 million paid accounts (+23.2%) and annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $365 million (+15.6%).
The mechanism recalls razors and blades: the device gets the customer in, and the service comes back every month.

encadre.texte: A physical product can open the door to a recurring service: what counts is what a paying account earns over time.

articles.titre: Searching a site and finding nothing
articles.chapo: According to Baymard, 56% of e-commerce sites handle what people come looking for poorly.
paragraphes: In an October 2, 2026 article, the Baymard Institute notes that 56% of sites fail to adequately support users' search needs. Its advice: a real field with a visible button, keyword suggestions (not only products), the query kept on the results page.
For a few hundred products, an icon that expands into a field can be enough; for a catalog of 10,000 items, an always-visible bar with suggestions is justified.

encadre.texte: An internal-search audit for independent shops: test 50 real queries (typos, synonyms, references), deliver an illustrated report of failures and a fix. Competition: Baymard already runs UX audits; the angle is the small merchant, at a flat fee.

articles.titre: A product comparison tool, $16 million claimed
articles.chapo: A clothing brand credits this gain to a single tool: comparing items right in the list.
paragraphes: On October 7, 2026, Baymard published a testimonial from a premium clothing brand with technical lines, which says it gained $16 million in revenue across its site and app. The change: a product comparison tool on listing pages, recommended by a UX audit (guideline no. 495).

Caution: the figure is reported by the client, with no period or method to isolate the tool's effect, and the text is published by a company that sells these audits. The title speaks of a "single" insight, while the text mentions a full-site audit.

encadre.texte: Take two similar products from your shop: if a stranger opens three tabs to choose, comparison is missing.

articles.titre: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: a local agent that activates only 2 billion parameters
articles.chapo: Liquid AI publishes an open model built to run on a laptop.
paragraphes: On October 13, Liquid AI published LFM2.5-24B-A2B on Hugging Face. The model has 24 billion parameters but activates only 2 billion for each token produced (a "mixture of experts" architecture). It reasons before answering and accepts 131,000 tokens of context.
Announced speeds: 184 tokens per second on an Apple M5 Max, 114 on a Ryzen AI Max+ 395. On AutomationBench it scores 27.69 against 8.72 for the best competitor cited.
But it lags on code: 51.0 on SWE-Bench Verified against 66.2 for a competitor. The license is not specified: check before any commercial use.

encadre.texte: An agent that runs on the customer's machine avoids sending data to a cloud: an argument for sensitive trades (health, law, accounting).

articles.titre: GitHub blocks Anthropic keys by default
paragraphes: Announced October 13: GitHub now blocks Anthropic API keys at push by default, even on free public repositories. Detectors were also added for Salesforce and Cloudsmith.

mot.definition: Short for annual recurring revenue: what current subscriptions would bring in over a year. At Arlo it reaches $365 million (p. 2).

chiffre.texte: of sites handle their visitors' searches poorly (Baymard).

bonus.texte: “Good design is as little design as possible.”

enigme.question: Sold once, I only pay off when renewed every month. What am I?
